title: Scalar cohomology pullback around a commutative square
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $A,B,C,D$ schemes [def-pc-scheme] with structure morphisms $f_A,f_B,f_C,f_D$ to $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$. Let $a:A\to B$, $b:B\to D$, $c:A\to C$, $d:C\to D$ satisfy $f_B\circ a=f_A$, $f_D\circ b=f_B$, $f_C\circ c=f_A$, $f_D\circ d=f_C$, and let $h:b\circ a=d\circ c$. Let $F$ be a module sheaf on $D$, $n\in\mathbb N$, and $x\in H_k^n(D,F)$ with operations as in [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $\sigma:a^*b^*F\to c^*d^*F$ be the hom of scalarPullbackSquareIso, the first inverse composition comparison, equality $h$, and second composition comparison, using normalized tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $H_k^n(\sigma)(a^*(b^*x))=c^*(d^*x)$. There are no compactness, affine-diagonal or quasi-coherence hypotheses.

source.place: Cohomology Tag 01FD (lemma-functoriality-cech), resolution lifts; Sheaves Tag 0097 (lemma-push-pull-composition-modules); lem-sc-picard-kunneth-qcoh Step 8. Official sources https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FD and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0097

proof.text: Apply scalarCohomologyPullback_comp to a then b and to c then d. The equality h identifies pullback along the two composites; prove this equality transport by elimination of h and the identity law of the cohomology functor. The private scalarMap_three_iso combines these two composition identities: coefficient functoriality splits the square isomorphism into its three factors; the first inverse comparison gives the first composite pullback, equality transport gives the second composite pullback, and the second comparison cancels its inverse. All four algebra helpers are proved from Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_id, equality elimination and iso cancellation. The target signature and unit route are unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCohomologyPullback_square
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (A B C D : Scheme.{w})
    (fA : A ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (fB : B ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (fC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (fD : D ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (c : A ⟶ C) (d : C ⟶ D)
    (ha : a ≫ fB = fA) (hb : b ≫ fD = fB)
    (hc : c ≫ fC = fA) (hd : d ≫ fD = fC) (h : a ≫ b = c ≫ d)
    (F : D.Modules) (n : ℕ) (x : scalarCohomology fD F n) :
    scalarCohomologyMap fA (scalarPullbackSquareIso a b c d h F).hom n
        (scalarCohomologyPullback fB fA a ha ((tensorPullback b).obj F) n
          (scalarCohomologyPullback fD fB b hb F n x)) =
      scalarCohomologyPullback fC fA c hc ((tensorPullback d).obj F) n
        (scalarCohomologyPullback fD fC d hd F n x)
